spec_ref.description: kebab-case slug of the docs/agent_behavior_spec.md ### heading this scenario covers

requirement_ref.description: docs/requirements/<n>.md this scenario is blocked on, if any

mock_response.description: required for mode=step: raw text returned by the (mocked) game engine

mock_extracted.description: required for mode=step: dict returned by the (mocked) LLM extraction

expect_action_startswith.description: decision mode: the chosen action must start with this string

expect_action_equals.description: decision mode: the chosen action must equal this string

expect_contains.description: post-step state[key] (list or dict) must contain each given value/key

expect_absent.description: post-step state[key] (list or dict) must NOT contain each given value/key

xfail.description: if present, the scenario is marked pytest.xfail with this reason instead of being run
